Class BedrockRealmHubService

java.lang.Object
com.viaversion.viafabricplus.bedrock.realms.BedrockRealmHubService
public final class BedrockRealmHubService extends Object
REST requests used by the Bedrock Realm Hub. The world list is provided by MinecraftAuth.
